A.notes: The courtyard-and-brick idea is clear in the hero plan, restrained palette, and the project drawings, and the site stays calm and usable on desktop and mobile. But the overall structure feels fairly conventional for an architecture portfolio, and the scroll-frame strip shows little motion beyond normal page progression, so I can't credit it as story-bearing animation.

B.notes: This has a much stronger singular identity: the brick-course hero, monumental serif typography, and plan/elevation presentation all feel specific to the brief and carry through the whole page. The work is polished and distinctive, though the motion evidence is still limited in the scroll strip, so I only see basic progression rather than a clear scroll-driven narrative.

raw.why: B turns the brief into a more coherent and memorable visual system, with more distinctive typography and a stronger architectural signature while still passing the measured checks.
